test_cases.title: Registered user receives valid reset link within 30 minutes
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user receives a valid reset link within 30 minutes of requesting it.
preconditions: The user is registered and has a valid email address associated with their account.

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a form to enter the email address associated with the account.

steps.action: User enters their registered email address and submits the form.
steps.expected_result: The system sends a reset link to the email address, and the user sees a confirmation message indicating the link has been sent.

steps.action: The user checks their email within 30 minutes of submission.
steps.expected_result: The user receives a reset link in their inbox, valid for 30 minutes, and visible in the email body.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

test_cases.title: Unregistered email receives visible confirmation but no reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that an unregistered email address does not receive a reset link, even if it appears to trigger a confirmation.
preconditions: The email address entered is not registered in the system.
The system has no record of the email address.

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a form to enter the email address associated with the account.

steps.action: User enters an unregistered email address and submits the form.
steps.expected_result: The system shows a visible confirmation message (e.g., 'We have sent a reset link to your email') but does not send an actual reset link.

steps.action: The user checks their email after submission.
steps.expected_result: No reset link is found in the inbox, confirming no email was sent.

source_requirements: An unregistered email address receives the same visible confirmation, but no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset link is used only once and becomes invalid after use
test_cases.objective: Verify that a reset link is used only once and becomes invalid after use.
preconditions: A registered user has successfully received a reset link via email.
The user has not yet used the link to change their password.

steps.action: User opens the reset link in their email and navigates to the password reset page.
steps.expected_result: The system allows the user to enter a new password and confirms the reset is complete.

steps.action: The user attempts to use the same reset link again, either by re-opening the email or by navigating to the reset page with the same link.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the link has already been used.

source_requirements: A reset link can be used only once.

test_cases.title: New password must satisfy configured password policy
test_cases.objective: Verify that the new password meets the configured password policy when resetting.
preconditions: A registered user has received a reset link.
The password policy requires at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one lowercase, and one number.

steps.action: User opens the reset link and enters a new password that meets the configured password policy (e.g., 'Pass1234').
steps.expected_result: The system accepts the password and allows the user to complete the reset process.

steps.action: User attempts to enter a password that does not meet the policy (e.g., 'pass').
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the password and displays an error message indicating the password does not meet the policy.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the configured password policy.

test_cases.title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes of being sent
test_cases.objective: Verify that the reset link expires after 30 minutes of being sent.
preconditions: A registered user has successfully received a reset link.
The system sends the link at a known time (e.g., 10:00 AM).

steps.action: User receives the reset link at 10:00 AM and immediately opens it to begin the password reset.
steps.expected_result: The system allows the user to enter a new password and completes the reset.

steps.action: User attempts to use the same link at 10:31 AM, after 30 minutes have passed.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the link and displays an error message indicating it has expired.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

test_cases.title: Invalid input (empty email) results in visible error
test_cases.objective: Verify that invalid input (e.g., empty email) results in a rejection with a visible error.
preconditions: The user is attempting to request a password reset.
The email field is required and cannot be left blank.

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link and enters an empty email field.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a visible error message indicating the email field is required.

steps.action: User attempts to submit the form without entering any email.
steps.expected_result: The form does not proceed, and the user sees a validation error message.

source_requirements: An unregistered email address receives the same visible confirmation, but no reset email is sent.
